name: Helicopter headset
about: A pilot on the cabin intercom, the rotor thumping right through the headset.

name: Shouting over the rotors
about: Yelling beside a running helicopter with the doors open and the wind tearing past.

name: Traffic report from the sky
about: A news reporter high over the freeway, punchy and squeezed, blades beating under every word.

name: Rotor spinning up
about: The blades start slowly and wind up to full speed while you talk right through them.

name: Rescue crew on the winch
about: A rescuer hanging from the winch line, radio clipping, rotor wash roaring through the open door.

name: Talking into a buzzing drone
about: A little drone hovers over your head and your voice buzzes through its tiny propellers.

name: Big twin-rotor transport
about: Slow heavy rotor beats under a harsh crew radio in a huge transport helicopter.

name: Captain speaking from the cockpit
about: The calm announcement over the cabin speakers, chime and engine hum included.

name: Seatmate on a long flight
about: The person beside you leans over to talk above the steady roar of the cabin.

name: Safety talk before takeoff
about: A squashed, rattly cabin speaker far up the aisle runs through the safety talk.

name: Small plane cockpit
about: A pilot's headset in a little propeller plane, the buzz of the prop riding on the voice.

name: Pilot calling the tower
about: A harsh, squeezed radio call to the control tower with a squelch tail on every line.

name: Fighter pilot oxygen mask
about: Talking into a tight rubber mask on a clipped radio while the jet roars around you.

name: Cargo plane hold
about: Shouting in the bare metal hold of a cargo plane, the engines roaring all around.

name: Announcement in rough air
about: The seatbelt chime rings and the captain's voice shakes with every bump.

name: Glider in silent air
about: Gliding high above the fields with only the wind whistling over the canopy.

name: Jumping out the plane door
about: Shouting at the open door of a plane, the wind battering every word.

name: Old propeller airliner
about: A honky little loudspeaker on a 1950s propeller airliner with the engines droning.

name: Train conductor over the speaker
about: The conductor's voice crackles from a little speaker above the seats as the wheels clatter.

name: Next stop announcement
about: A squashed, rattling speaker calls the next stop over the roar of an underground train.

name: Rattling old subway car
about: Talking to a friend over the screech and roar of an old underground train.

name: Sleeper train at night
about: A soft voice in a tiny sleeping compartment while the train rocks through the night.

name: From the next carriage
about: Someone calls to you through the connecting door from the next carriage along.

name: Steam train, all aboard
about: A conductor calls along the platform while the steam engine hisses and clanks.

name: High-speed train cabin
about: A smooth modern announcement gliding over the hush of a very fast train.

name: Runaway mine cart
about: Bouncing through a rocky tunnel in a rattling cart, your voice shaking at every bump.

name: Riding a city tram
about: Chatting on a rattling street tram as its bell clangs at every crossing.

name: Platform speaker echo
about: Your voice booms from the platform speakers as a train rumbles in under the tiles.

name: Taxi in city traffic
about: Chatting from the front seat of a cab as it noses through busy traffic.

name: Bus driver on the speaker
about: The driver's handset buzzes through a rattly speaker over the growling diesel.

name: Back seat of the bus
about: Talking right over the engine at the very back of a bus bouncing down the highway.

name: Windows down on the highway
about: Raising your voice over the wind blasting through open car windows at speed.

name: Rainy drive home
about: A cosy car at night, wipers swishing while the rain drums on the roof.

name: Turn-by-turn navigation voice
about: A flat, even direction-giving voice from the phone on the dashboard.

name: Long-haul truck cab
about: A boomy big cab rolling down rough highway, tyres roaring under you.

name: Police car roof speaker
about: Orders blare from the roof speaker of a patrol car after a quick whoop of the siren.

name: Through a closed car window
about: Someone in a parked car talks to you through the glass on a busy street.

name: Ambulance crew radio
about: A paramedic radios in from the back of an ambulance racing through traffic, siren wailing.

name: School bus field trip
about: A whole busload of you chattering away on a bumpy ride to somewhere fun.

name: Race car team radio
about: A driver radios the pit wall, digital and distorted, the engine screaming behind the words.

name: Motorcycle helmet
about: Talking inside a full-face helmet at speed, wind roaring round the shell.

name: Rider to passenger intercom
about: A helmet-to-helmet radio between rider and passenger on an open road.

name: Racetrack announcer
about: The track speakers call the race over a crowd on its feet.

name: Words made of engine noise
about: Your words come out of a growling engine instead of your mouth.

name: Engine revs as you talk
about: A motor revs up under every word you say and drops back to idle in the pauses.

name: Dirt bike on a forest trail
about: A rider zips back and forth through the trees, the engine snarling under each pass.

name: Go-kart laps
about: A buzzing little kart whips past you lap after lap.

name: Ship captain on deck
about: Calling orders across an open deck with gulls, clinking rigging and a foghorn.

name: Bridge to engine room
about: A buzzing ship's intercom squawks orders down into a steel engine room.

name: Fishing boat radio
about: A hissy marine radio call from a fishing boat chugging through the swell.

name: Ferry crossing announcement
about: A horn speaker on the open deck of a big ferry, its words slapping back off the cabins.

name: Below deck in the engine room
about: Shouting over pounding steam machinery deep in the belly of an old ship.

name: Sailing at sunset
about: Relaxing aboard a small sailboat, rigging tinking and water lapping at the hull.

name: Lifeboat in rough seas
about: Shouting from a little lifeboat tossed on huge crashing waves.

name: Speedboat bouncing on waves
about: Hanging on in a roaring speedboat as it slams over the chop.

name: Creaking wooden ship hold
about: Below deck on an old wooden ship, the timbers groaning with every wave.

name: Rowing on a still lake
about: Calling out from a rowboat, your voice coming back off the far shore.

name: Submarine captain
about: Orders over the boat's speakers ring through a steel hull while sonar pings outside.

name: Quiet in the sonar room
about: Talking in hushed tones in a small steel room while sonar pings ring into the deep.

name: Hull groaning under pressure
about: Deep down in a narrow steel passage, your voice wavering as the hull groans.

name: Deep-sea diving helmet
about: A diver in a brass helmet talks up the line, bubbles streaming past the glass.

name: Inside a diving bell
about: Breathing a helium mix inside a cramped metal bell on the sea floor.

name: Underwater telephone to the ship
about: The warbling through-water phone between a small sub and the ship above.

name: Launch control countdown
about: Mission radio with beep tones as the rocket roars off the pad.

name: Shaking cockpit at liftoff
about: Strapped in on top of the rocket, your radio voice rattling as the engines light.

name: Starship bridge captain
about: Speaking from the captain's chair on a vast humming bridge full of chirping consoles.

name: Red alert on the bridge
about: The ship-wide speakers crackle with orders as the alarm whoops.

name: Escape pod drifting
about: A faint, breaking-up call from a cramped pod drifting away from the ship.

name: Moon buggy ride
about: Bouncing across the moon in a little rover, your radio voice jolting on every bump.

name: Starship captain's log
about: A close, late-night personal log recorded on a quiet, humming bridge.

name: Jump to light speed
about: Your voice stretches upward and swirls as the ship surges into a jump.

name: Re-entry radio blackout
about: The capsule radio breaks up in the roaring heat of coming home.

name: Passing car
about: Someone shouts from a car window as it whooshes past, again and again.

name: Siren passing by
about: A loudspeaker car wails past you, siren and voice both dropping in pitch.

name: Express train roaring past
about: A voice blares from a speeding train as it thunders by the crossing.

name: Jet flyover
about: Your voice screams overhead like a low jet, whooshing as it goes.

name: Cyclist rolling by
about: A chatty cyclist rides past you, turns round and rides back again.

name: Race cars down the straight
about: Lap after lap your voice tears past the grandstand at racing speed.

name: Bus pulling away
about: Someone calls from inside a bus as it pulls off down the street.

name: Skateboarder rolling past
about: A skater rolls by you twice down a narrow alley, words bouncing off the walls.

name: Motorbike zooming past
about: A snarling motorbike rips past from right to left with every phrase.

name: Ice cream van crawling past
about: A tinny van loudspeaker calls out to the kids as it crawls slowly past down your street.

name: Roller coaster drop
about: Screaming on a coaster as it hurtles past you over and over.

name: Hot air balloon basket
about: Floating high and calm, with the burner roaring above you now and then.

name: Riding the carousel
about: You circle round and round on a painted horse while the band organ plays.

name: Spinning teacups ride
about: Whirling round in a giant teacup, your voice dizzy and wobbling.

name: Bumper car crashes
about: Jolted from side to side as the bumper cars slam into you.

name: Zip line over the valley
about: Whizzing past you on a zip line, your shout echoing down the valley.

name: Sledding down a snowy hill
about: Shrieking with joy as you slide away down a long snowy hill.

name: Top of the big wheel
about: Calling down from the top of the big wheel, the fair glittering far below.

name: Tank crew intercom
about: A crew member on a throat mic inside a clanking steel tank, the diesel roaring all round.

name: Tractor cab at dawn
about: Chatting from a rattling tractor cab as the old engine chugs and the farmyard wakes up.

name: Digger driver on the building site
about: A digger driver radios the crew over the hammering and sawing of a busy building site.

name: Crane driver shouting down
about: The crane driver leans out of a tiny cab high above you and shouts down to the ground.

name: Tow truck on the CB radio
about: A tow truck driver calls in on a crackling CB radio while rolling down a rough highway.

name: Snowplow cab at night
about: Talking low in a warm plow cab, the engine grumbling as snow blows hard against the glass.

name: Forklift round the warehouse
about: Calling out from a forklift as it zips back and forth across a huge echoing warehouse.
